articles.title: North Korea’s Kim Jong Un sets stage for daughter as his successor: Seoul
articles.summary: South Korea's spy agency now believes North Korean leader Kim Jong Un is preparing to designate his daughter, Kim Ju Ae, as his successor, significantly strengthening their earlier assessment. This potential move marks a pivotal development in North Korea's leadership, holding substantial implications for future regional stability and international relations, vital for strategic understanding.

articles.title: The $10 Trillion Fight: Modeling a US-China War Over Taiwan
articles.summary: Taiwan holds immense global economic importance, being the primary producer of advanced semiconductors crucial for the booming Artificial Intelligence industry. This strategic concentration, however, places the island nation on significant geological and geopolitical fault lines. Its pivotal role in the tech supply chain, coupled with inherent vulnerabilities, creates complex international challenges affecting technological advancement and global stability.

articles.title: Trade deals, capex push boost India's aero, defence outlook: Goldman Sachs
articles.summary: Goldman Sachs has highlighted significant growth tailwinds for India's defence sector. These include an anticipated 18% year-on-year increase in capital procurement within the Union defence budget for FY27. Additionally, the proposed India-EU Free Trade Agreement is expected to further boost the sector, indicating strong opportunities for defence industries and strategic partnerships.
